current_view_policy.currency_assumption: NPR; requested by the owner; original source currency remains unconfirmed
current_view_policy.replacement_rates: None; original estimate values remain unchanged
current_view_policy.scope: Measurement compatibility does not establish matching labour, material, grade, installation, VAT or stock
current_view_policy.snapshot_note: Original/v0–v13 are focused views. The v9 register defines current works, quantities and price evidence; v12 adds responsibility rules and work-ID links; v13 derives the group budgets and comparison. Dated exports and frozen milestones retain their original evidence.

construction_contents: 3D assembly, material quantities and drawing downloads
workspace_navigation.progress_scope: Four-project extraction checkpoints, roadmaps, source hierarchy and historical records. Website deliverable status is not presented as physical construction progress.

data_architecture.publication: Every source commit runs the existing GitHub Actions build and refreshes all derived views together.
data_architecture.historical_evidence: Original PDF/raw extraction, dated research exports and released milestones remain evidence snapshots.
data_architecture.draft_policy: V8 browser models are temporary scenarios. V10 and v11 share contractor inputs saved on the same browser by source revision and can export as a material CSV. Neither changes the published register or other views until the chosen values are committed to the shared source.
data_architecture.inline_material_view: V11 renders the v10 projection and loads the same generated v10 contractor-data.json; no separately edited material register.
data_architecture.current_views: Original/v0: quoted source; v2: concise scope/hierarchy; v3: SI conversion; v4: price observations; v5: comparisons; v5.1: graphs; v6: images; v7: components; v8: quantity models; v9: internal register; v10: worksheets; v11: inline materials; v12: responsibility decisions. V13: original group budgets and owner-managed savings comparison.
data_architecture.procurement_view: V12 stores no copied work titles, quantities or quoted rates. Work-ID and area-ID decisions join the shared register at build time. New carpet/vanity options are outside the quote and have unknown quantities.
data_architecture.savings_view: V13 generates its budgets from v9 quoted amounts and v12 work-ID responsibility links. No separate editable work-price register. Complete alternative owner costs are browser-only scenarios keyed to both source revisions; they do not change published rates or v10/v11 drafts.
